description: This file provides utility functions for table manipulation, including normalization of values for sorting, sorting tables with stability, pagination, and adjusting page indices. It is framework-agnostic and intended to be used across multiple pages in a frontend project.

methods.name: normalizeSortValue(value)
methods.description: Normalizes a value for sorting comparison, handling null/undefined, numbers, booleans, Date objects, and strings (including ISO date strings).

methods.name: sortRows(rows, { sortKey, sortOrder = "asc", accessor })
methods.description: Sorts an array of rows based on a specified key, order, and accessor function, maintaining stability.

methods.name: paginateRows(rows, { pageIndex = 0, pageSize = 10 } = {})
methods.description: Paginates an array of rows based on page index and size, returning sliced rows along with total counts.

methods.name: clampPageIndex(pageIndex, totalPages)
methods.description: Adjusts a page index to ensure it remains within the valid range given total pages.
